title: Module 1: Black Boxes, Interpretability, and the Right to Explanation
description: Distinguish interpretability from explainability, evaluate post-hoc explanation methods, and meet the legal-and-ethical floor for meaningful explanations under GDPR, EU AI Act, and FCRA.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish interpretability (property of the model) from explainability (property of the explanation surface)
Compare feature attribution, counterfactual, and example-based explanation methods and their limits
State three properties of a meaningful explanation (faithful, actionable, contextually appropriate) and apply them to a real case
Identify the relevant regulatory framework (GDPR Art. 22, EU AI Act, FCRA) for a given deployment context

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
